title: Enterprise data request routing and escalation playbook
creator: Leah Martin
description: Create a deterministic intake, routing, and escalation playbook for enterprise customer requests related to data governance controls (logging redaction, retention windows, PII handling, audit export formats). This playbook should reduce time-to-resolution for high-risk requests, provide a prioritization rubric for PM/Eng/Security, and define clear owner handoffs and SLA buckets. It must be usable by Solutions Eng, Support, and Sales to set expectations with customers and feed predictable work into the roadmap.
problem_statement: Enterprise customers are submitting ad-hoc requests for logging/PII controls that are currently handled inconsistently across Sales, Support, and Eng. This leads to mis-scoped work, SLA misses, and hidden security risk. We need a repeatable triage process that balances regulatory urgency, implementation cost, and product alignment.
goals: Produce a 1-page intake form and decision checklist for Support/Sales
Define a 3-level severity and SLA matrix for data governance requests
Create a prioritization rubric that scales across customer size and regulatory regimes
Document routing & escalation steps to Security, Compliance, and Runtime Eng
Ship a pull request to internal docs + train 3 teams (Support, Solutions Eng, Sales)
acceptance_criteria: Draft intake form added to Confluence with example filled cases
Prioritization rubric validated by Security and two pilot enterprise customers
Triage playbook published in internal docs and linked from Support KB
At least two request types (log redaction, retention change) have end-to-end owner and rough ETA defined
Training session scheduled and recorded for Support and Solutions Eng
proposed_workflow: 1) Customer or AE submits a Data Controls Intake form (Support ticket template). 2) Automated parsing tags request with: PII=true/false, Compliance scope (GDPR/CCPA/PCI/HIPAA), Customer tier, Contracted SLA. 3) Tier routing: immediate escalation to Security for high-risk/PHI/contractual obligations; Solutions Eng for scoping; PM for prioritization. 4) Apply prioritization rubric; assign to backlog bucket: Quick Config (<=2w), Roadmap Candidate (quarterly planning), Escalated Patch (P0, engineering hotfix). 5) Communicate timeline to customer and log in backlog with linking to intake ID and discovery notes.
prioritization_rubric: Score across: Regulatory Risk (0-5), PII Sensitivity (0-5), Contractual Obligation (0-5), Revenue Impact (0-5), Implementation Effort (0-5, inverted). Total score maps to: 16+ => P0 Escalate, 10-15 => P1 Short-term, 6-9 => P2 Candidate, <=5 => P3 Backlog. Add override flag for 'Security Required' which forces escalation regardless of score.
triage_matrix_examples: Example A: Fortune 50 customer requests full request/response audit export for legal discovery -> Regulatory Risk 5, PII 4, Contract 5 => Escalate to Security + PM (P0)
Example B: Mid-market customer asks for 90-day retention instead of 7-day default for non-sensitive logs -> Regulatory Risk 2, PII 1, Contract 2 => Roadmap Candidate (P2)
Example C: Startup requests redaction at ingestion for IP-like PII in prompt text -> Regulatory Risk 3, PII 3, Effort 4 => Short-term config or SDK guidance (P1)
Example D: Partner asks for CSV audit export format that is low-sensitivity and no contract SLA -> Low priority (P3)
routing_and_escalation_steps: - Initial review by Support within 2 business days to collect intake fields and annotate Compliance tags. - If Security Required or Regulatory Risk >=4, tag and page Security+PM and set target response <24h. - If Implementation Effort <=2 and no contractual constraints, Solutions Eng implements as Quick Config. - For changes requiring Runtime or infra changes (batching/retention infra, redaction hooks), create ENG ticket and mark dependency for Dedicated/Private customers. - PM decides inclusion in next sprint or creates roadmap epic for Q planning.
stakeholders: Sales AE: assigned AE depending on account
